items.name: Malta Open 2019

venue.name: [The University of Malta](https://www.um.edu.mt/)
venue.address: Mathematics and Physics Building, University of Malta, Msida MSD 2080, Malta.

items.information: This is the first WCA competition in Malta. It is an open competition for all people from all ages and all countries. We hope many people from Malta and other countries will participate. The competition also counts as the national championship for Malta. So the best competitors from Malta will be the national champions 2019 of Malta. Doors are open from 8:30am.

items.name: Maltese Championship 2026
items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MjAxNzQ1LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--417935762bfb96f37d3a4122e860cb7a459231ec/91697.jpg) Welcome to Maltese Championship 2026, the fourth official WCA competition in Malta! Whether you’re competing for the first time or returning for another competition, we’re excited to welcome you to our growing speedcubing community. Competitors from all countries are warmly invited to take part. While prizes and national titles are reserved for Maltese competitors, every participant will compete on equal terms and receive official WCA results. Our aim is to make Maltese Championship 2026 our biggest and most welcoming competition yet, bringing together cubers of all ages and experience levels for a memorable day of competition and community. Be sure to check all tabs, especially [if you are a new competitor](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/MalteseChampionship2026#76640-for-new-competitors). **Registration is only possible online through this website. Check the [Register](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/MalteseChampionship2026/register) section for details.** [T-shirts are available to order](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/MalteseChampionship2026#78743-championship-t-shirt-competitors-supporters) for competitors and supporters by the 6th September 2026.
